title.narrative: National Phase-out of Methyl Bromide - Terminal Project

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to assist methyl bromide users in phasing-out 170 ODP tonnes (282 metric tonnes) presently used mainly in the production of tomatoes, strawberries (fruit and runners) and be prepared to the phased out in 2015. Impact of project on country's Montreal Protocol obligations: Through the implementation of this Project, Chile will phase-out all controlled uses of methyl bromide, leading the country to compliance with the 2015 deadline.
